answer: Use a micro-batch job with a 10 second trigger reading the order event log, not record-at-a-time streaming. The screen is glanced at about once a minute, so the SLA is about 1 minute, and a 10 second trigger keeps the worst case well under it. The team already runs a batch engine, so micro-batch reuses that engine, functions, deploy pipeline and skills. Its failure unit is one cycle, which reruns whole, so nobody needs to be paged overnight, unlike an always-on stream with in-memory state. A 1 minute trigger would push the worst case past the glance interval. Keep finance totals as a nightly batch recompute from the same log.
